algebraic_guardrail_notes.E0_tower_exact_simplification: With hbar_q = (q - 1)/q, E_0^tower = E_0^(M=0) / (1 - hbar_q^2) = [m_e / (q(q - 1))] / [(2q - 1)/q^2] = m_e * q / ((q - 1)(2q - 1)) approx 4.227483 MeV (+0.9915% over M=0 4.185981 MeV). Note: do NOT confuse (1 - hbar_q^2) with (q^2 - 1), which would give m_e / ((q-1)^2(q+1)) approx 42.2 MeV (10x error).
algebraic_guardrail_notes.two_term_pin_derivative_sign: d ln(m_p^QCD/m_e) / d ln q approx -20.997 < 0 at q_0, so subtracting positive M_p^QED > 0 lowers target M_p^QCD and INCREASES q_2t above 1-term q_proton by +11.17 ppb (closing 96.2% of the 211.2 ppb mu-p gap).
